scope: Synthetic phase-difference recovery using SN 2006mk native pixel errors; not an observed aging measurement
known_limitations: Processed template resolution and original noise are not deconvolved
Median flux fixes a conditional amplitude scale, not a measured continuum
Native errors treated independent; covariance not supplied
Catalog heliocentric redshift used with barycentric spectra as approximate coordinate mapping only
No host residuals, selection or source evolution modeled
Exposed nearby objects and distant metadata; no blind claim
